crossRefs.note: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on…
I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but…
‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons…
Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a…
They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry…
“Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
(for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of…
For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls…
A revelation, Yahweh’s word concerning Israel. Yahweh, who stretches out the heavens, and lays the foundation of the…
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…
“Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty…

translations.web: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all things.
translations.bsb: Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
translations.kjv: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
